missing_data_treatment: ECCC wins where RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV is transparent (verified authoritative coverage); IEM N0Q fills ECCC gaps natively; OPERA EU radar fills remaining non-NA gaps; translucent GFS model estimates only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere; never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.

legend_scale_html: Precipitation intensity (NEXRAD N0Q base reflectivity, dBZ, OBSERVED radar echo): LOWEST 5 Very Light cyan/blue (drizzle, mist) → Light greens (~20-30: light rain/snow) → Moderate dark green (~30-40: steady rain/snow) → Heavy yellow/orange (~40-50: heavy rain) → Severe red (~50-60: severe storms, hail possible) → Intense magenta/purple (~60-70: violent storms, large hail) → HIGHEST+ 70+ Extreme white (destructive hail, debris). Same dBZ always shows the same color in every season — rain, snow, lake-effect snow, thunderstorms. No echo (no precipitation) stays see-through so the map underneath shows. Measurement types differ by source: IEM N0Q and OPERA are MEASURED reflectivity (dBZ); ECCC rain colors are ESTIMATED dBZ equivalents converted from rain rates via Z=300R^1.4 (ECCC publishes mm/h, not dBZ — high-rate classes saturate near ~57 dBZ, so ECCC never paints the white extreme row); ECCC snow blues are severity-rank matched, not dBZ; pale/muted colors are GFS MODEL estimates (6-h mean rates), never radar. ECCC snow echoes render blue ONLY where SfcPrecipType classifies snow (mixed/freezing rain render on the dBZ key at matched severity). Muted colors = GFS model estimates (same order, not radar).

na_bounds.note: Authoritative common geography for the GLOBAL coverage variant of the four live gradients (wind_na, precipitation_na, cloud_cover_na, air_temperature_na). Same 0.10 deg/px grid as aurora_global. Basin + North America variants keep their existing canvases; only the former extended200 variant moves here. Areas without valid source data stay transparent.
